_README: Figures that do not come from a scored run in reports/results/. Every entry needs a `source` saying where it can be re-derived. export_numbers.py turns each into a LaTeX macro of the same name and copies the source into a comment above it. Keys must be letters only (LaTeX macro names).

GeomWrongMedian.note: median anchor-to-distractor distance; the two medians differ in the third decimal

GeomRightCloser.note: per cent of triples where the chosen candidate is the nearer one

GeomAngle.note: MEDIAN angle in degrees between the two displacement vectors (not mean)

AnnThemePct.source: majority of annotators marked the dimension; dev and test pooled, n=600. Verified by recomputation 17 Nov: 590/317/144 of 600 exactly
AnnThemePct.note: per triple, majority rule. The three are independent checkboxes, so they do not sum to 100.

AnnActionPct.source: majority of annotators marked the dimension; dev and test pooled, n=600. Verified by recomputation 17 Nov: 590/317/144 of 600 exactly
AnnActionPct.note: per triple, majority rule. The three are independent checkboxes, so they do not sum to 100.

AnnOutcomePct.source: majority of annotators marked the dimension; dev and test pooled, n=600. Verified by recomputation 17 Nov: 590/317/144 of 600 exactly
AnnOutcomePct.note: per triple, majority rule. The three are independent checkboxes, so they do not sum to 100.

AnnCommentCount.note: From the same notebook pass as the dimension counts, which did reproduce exactly; this figure has not itself been independently recomputed.
